title: External mechanical force drives axonal cytoskeletal rearrangements
authors: Grace L. Swaim, Oliver V. Glomb, Yi Xie, Chloe Emerson, Zhuoyuan Li, Daniel Beaudet, Adam G. Hendricks, Shaul Yogev
abstract: Swaim et al. identify dynamic rearrangements of the axonal cytoskeleton that occur in response to external mechanical forces. This response requires axonal Talin, RhoA, and myosin and is important for maintaining the continuity of the microtubule cytoskeleton.

title: Genomic insights into photosymbiosis in giant clams and comparisons with coral strategies
authors: Taiga Uchida, Hiroshi Yamashita, Go Shimada, Mayumi Kawamitsu, Eiichi Shoguchi, Chuya Shinzato
abstract: Uchida et al. present a chromosome-scale genome and transcriptomic analyses of the photosymbiotic giant clam Tridacna crocea.
